note: This 64 KiB dump is not a straight copy of the first flash bank: its first 48 KiB are flash sectors 16-27 (the newest copy's sectors 2-13, from the second bank) and its last 16 KiB are sectors 12-15, so neither copy is whole after the import and every core reports the save as deleted. Put back where they belong (0x0000-0xBFFF to 0x10000-0x1BFFF), the newest copy is complete again (checked in mGBA: the corrupt-save message, then CONTINUE SETH 74:09); the converter does not do this, it follows mGBA.
